test_title: PYST 55: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence.

In my new office, all employees were different, so I felt like a__ fish out of water.__
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "like a fish out of water" means feeling uncomfortable or out of place in a particular situation.
 
• In the sentence, the speaker feels out of place in their new office because all the employees were different.
 
• This indicates that the speaker was uncomfortable in their new environment.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Homeless:** This option is incorrect because the idiom does not imply being without a home.
 
• **Frustrated:** While one might feel frustrated in an uncomfortable situation, the primary meaning of the idiom is feeling out of place.
 
• **Disappointed:** This option is incorrect because the idiom does not imply disappointment.
